Container.Name: personalcrm
Container.Overview:
A personal CRM for the people in your life — not a sales tool.
Track contacts, log interactions, keep the things you want to remember about someone, record important dates, and save conversation ideas for next time. Keep-in-touch cadences surface who you are overdue to reach out to. An optional dating layer adds a pipeline, a date log with ratings, green and red flags, and compatibility notes for people you are seeing.
Mobile-first, designed for quick entry from a phone and bulk entry from a desktop. MariaDB is built into the image, so this is a single container with a single appdata path and no external database to set up.
First run: open the WebUI and create your account. Everything stays on your server.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds the MariaDB database, the generated secrets file, and uploads and automatic plaintext database dumps. Back up and encrypt this path.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. 99 is the Unraid default (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as. 100 is the Unraid default (users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Reminders and 'overdue' calculations use it.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Full external URL you reach the app on, e.g. https://crm.example.com. Required for secure cookies behind HTTPS.

Config.Name: Disable signups
Config.Description: Set to true once your accounts exist to stop anyone else registering.

Config.Name: Backup time
Config.Description: Daily database dump time in 24-hour HH:MM, interpreted in TZ.

Config.Name: Backup retention days
Config.Description: Delete completed database dumps older than this many days after a successful backup.

Config.Name: Backup minimum free MiB
Config.Description: Refuse a backup when the backups directory has less than this much free space.

Config.Name: External database URL
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to use the MariaDB built into this container. Set it to use your own server, e.g. mysql://user:password@192.168.1.10:3306/personalcrm
